title: Optimized protocol for the generation of an orthotopic colon cancer mouse model and metastasis
author: Richon, Zajac, et al.
materials:
Timing: 7 days
Note: The culture media for the tumoroids should be used fresh and thus prepared on the same day when tumoroids are amplified and prepared for injection. The EDTA solution should be placed in a water bath heated to 50°C for 15 min before the injection of the cells.

steps.title: Prepare media and EDTA solution
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh culture media on the same day as cell amplification and make a 50 °C EDTA solution, heating it in a water bath for 15 min before cell injection.

substeps.instruction: Allocate 7 days for preparation of all equipment and materials.
Keep the culture media on ice and use it the same day it is prepared.
Heat the EDTA solution to 50 °C and maintain for 15 min prior to injection.

steps.title: Prepare cell line suspension
steps.instruction: Generate a 0.5 × 10⁶ cell suspension in 100 µL of 50:50 DMEM (no FBS) and Matrigel on ice for each mouse.

substeps.instruction: Remove existing culture medium from a T75 cm² flask using a 2 mL pipette.
Wash cells with 5 mL room‑temperature PBS.
Add 3 mL Tryplee Express to the flask and incubate at 37 °C until cells detach (≈3–5 min).
Add 15 mL culture medium containing 10 % FBS to inactivate Tryplee Express.
Take 10 µL of the suspension, mix with 10 µL trypan blue, load onto a counting chamber and determine cell concentration.
Calculate the volume needed to obtain 0.5 × 10⁶ viable cells in 100 µL; viability must be >80 % (normally >95 %).
Spin the cells 3 min at 231 g, discard supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL per mouse of a 1:1 mixture of DMEM (no FBS) and cold Matrigel; keep on ice.
The entire preparation takes 10–30 min (≈10 min for washing, ≈30 min for counting and resuspension).
The suspension can be kept on ice for up to 2 h without affecting tumor engraftment.

steps.title: Prepare tumoroid suspension
steps.instruction: Generate a 0.5 × 10⁶ tumoroid cell suspension in 100 µL of 50:50 DMEM/F12 (no FBS) and Matrigel on ice for each mouse.

substeps.instruction: Detach Matrigel drops from culture plates by gently scratching with the tip of a 1 mL pipette.
Aspirate each drop together with its medium using a 1 mL pipette and transfer to a 15 mL tube.
Add culture medium to the tube up to a total volume of 10 mL.
Centrifuge 10 min at 450 g at room temperature (19–22 °C).
Aspirate the supernatant and add 1 mL room‑temperature Tryplee Express to the pellet.
Incubate 3 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; verify under a microscope that tumoroids are dissociated into single cells or small clusters.
Add 5 mL medium to inactivate Tryplee Express.
Take 10 µL of the suspension, mix with 10 µL trypan blue, load onto a counting chamber and count cells (count cells in each cluster if present).
If viability is <80 % discard the preparation.
Spin the cells again 10 min at 450 g at room temperature; discard supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 100 µL per mouse of a 1:1 mixture of DMEM/F12 (no FBS) and cold Matrigel; keep on ice.
The preparation takes 10–30 min (≈10 min for centrifugation, ≈30 min for counting and resuspension).
The suspension can be kept on ice for up to 2 h without affecting tumor engraftment.

steps.title: Anesthetize and prep mouse
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse, administer analgesic, position, and clear the colon of feces before injection.

substeps.instruction: Induce anesthesia with 3 % isoflurane and a flow of 2 L min⁻¹ air until the mouse is asleep.
Reduce isoflurane to 2 % and airflow to 0.5 L min⁻¹ while maintaining anesthesia.
Apply tear gel to the eyes to prevent drying.
Inject 5 mg kg⁻¹ Carprofen (Rimadyl) diluted in 100 µL PBS subcutaneously as analgesic.
Place the mouse on its back, spread hind legs, and immobilize with surgical tape.
Gently massage the abdomen to expel feces; ensure the colon feels empty (do NOT wash with PBS or other solutions).
This preparation takes approximately 5 min per mouse.

steps.title: DAPI stain tissue sections
steps.instruction: Stain frozen tissue sections with DAPI and mount for imaging.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 25 µg mL⁻¹ DAPI in PBS to each tissue section.
Incubate 30 min at room temperature.
Remove DAPI solution, add 8 drops of Aquapolymount mounting medium, and cover with a 24 × 50 mm coverslip.
Allow the mount to dry for at least 1 h before imaging.
